arguments.message: It looks like you’re only pulling the first page of results. List endpoints return one page at a time and include a `next_cursor` field when more data exists. To get all records you need to keep requesting pages using that cursor until the response no longer contains a `next_cursor`. That’s why records beyond the first page appear to “vanish” if you don’t follow the pagination cursor.
